pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibit high-frequency serrated edges with irregular polygonal and star-like geometries. The pixel gradients at the boundaries are sharp, showing significant interdigitation with the lighter background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected topological graph of light-toned pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections with non-uniform pixel thickness that narrows between adjacent patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper cervical ridge displays a consistent sawtooth silhouette with low-amplitude, high-frequency projections created by individual hair tufts.
